name: Kendou Buchou
source:
A third year high school student who is the director of the Kendo club. He is an athletic and smart man, but he is also passionate. He is a little awkward with Naginata because it takes up a lot of space. He has a large number of members in the Kendo club itself, but he has the skill of losing the qualifying. He seems to know Yanagawa when he was in junior high school...?

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
